cluster around the fire: On the cold winter night, the campers began to cluster around the fire to keep warm and tell stories.
在寒冷的冬夜，露營者開始圍聚火邊取暖、說故事。
cluster together: During the snowstorm, the penguins cluster together in a tight group so that they can share their body heat.
暴風雪期間，企鵝們聚集一處擠成一團，以便分享彼此的體溫。
a cluster of houses: From the top of the mountain, we could see a cluster of houses hidden in the green valley below.
從山頂上，我們可以看到一群房屋藏在下方翠綠的山谷中。
coach a team: After she retired as a player, she was asked to coach a team of young girls who had never won a game.
她退役後，受邀執教一支從未贏過比賽的少女球隊。
coach someone for an exam: His parents hired a retired teacher to coach him for an exam, giving him extra lessons every weekend.
他的父母請了一位退休老師為他的考試輔導，每個週末幫他額外上課。
coach a witness: Lawyers are not allowed to coach a witness by telling them exactly what to say in court.
律師不得教唆證人，告訴他們在法庭上究竟該說什麼。
code a program: In the computer class, every student had to code a program that could tell users the weather for the week.
在電腦課上，每位學生都必須寫一個能告訴使用者本週天氣的程式。
crack the code: After working on the puzzle for three days, the clever students finally managed to crack the code and open the box.
花了三天解謎後，那群聰明的學生終於破解密碼，打開了箱子。
code of conduct: All employees must follow the company's code of conduct, which explains how to treat customers and coworkers.
所有員工都必須遵守公司的行為準則，其中說明了如何對待顧客和同事。
dress code: The restaurant has a strict dress code, so men must wear a jacket and are not allowed to enter in shorts.
這家餐廳有嚴格的服裝規定，所以男士必須穿外套，不准穿短褲進入。
coin a term: When scientists discover something completely new, they often need to coin a term because no existing word can describe it.
科學家發現全新事物時，常需要創造新詞，因為沒有現成的字能描述它。
coin a phrase: Shakespeare had a special talent: he could coin a phrase so fresh and memorable that people still use it today.
莎士比亞有一項特殊天分：他能創造出新鮮又令人難忘的說法，讓人們至今仍在使用。
the other side of the coin: Working from home saves time, but the other side of the coin is that you may feel lonely.
在家工作省時間，但另一面是你可能會感到孤單。
the economy collapsed: When the economy collapsed in 2008, many families lost their homes and millions of people lost their jobs.
2008年經濟崩潰時，許多家庭失去住所，數百萬人丟了工作。
the talks collapsed: The two countries could not agree on the new border, so the talks collapsed after only two days.
兩國無法就新邊界達成共識，因此談判僅僅兩天後就破裂了。
collapse from exhaustion: Halfway through the race in the burning heat, one runner seemed to collapse from exhaustion onto the track, and medics rushed over.
在酷熱中比賽到一半時，一名跑者似乎累倒在跑道上，醫護人員立刻衝了過去。
the roof collapsed: After days of heavy snow, the roof collapsed under the weight and crushed the car parked inside the garage.
連續下了幾天大雪後，屋頂因重量而倒塌，壓壞了停在車庫裡的車。
the company collapsed: Because of years of heavy debt, the company collapsed, and thousands of workers lost their jobs overnight.
由於多年的沉重債務，公司倒閉了，數千名員工一夜之間失業。
color one's judgment: When you make an important decision, try not to let your anger color your judgment.
做重要決定時，盡量別讓怒氣影響你的判斷。
color the facts: Some reporters color the facts to make their stories more exciting, so readers should always check other sources.
有些記者會扭曲事實讓報導更刺激，因此讀者應該隨時查證其他來源。
color one's view of: He used to like all his teachers, but one terrible experience in high school colored his view of teachers for years.
他以前喜歡所有老師，但高中時一次糟糕的經驗影響了他多年來對老師的看法。
combat crime: The city installed more street cameras and hired extra police officers to combat crime in the downtown area.
市政府裝設了更多街頭攝影機並增聘警員，以打擊市中心的犯罪。
combat climate change: Many countries have promised to use more solar and wind power to combat climate change.
許多國家承諾使用更多太陽能和風力發電來對抗氣候變遷。
combat poverty: The government started a new program that offers free job training to combat poverty in rural areas.
政府推出一項提供免費職業訓練的新計畫，以對抗鄉村地區的貧窮。
combat disease: Clean water and vaccines are two of the most effective ways to combat disease in poor countries.
乾淨的水和疫苗是貧窮國家對抗疾病最有效的兩種方式。
command respect: Our principal is fair and honest with everyone, so she is able to command respect from both students and teachers.
我們校長對每個人都公平又誠實，所以她能贏得學生和老師的尊敬。
command a high price: Because only a few were ever made, these old stamps command a high price at auctions today.
因為當年只製作了少數幾張，這些舊郵票如今在拍賣會上賣得高價。
command attention: The moment the famous singer walked onto the stage, she was able to command attention from the whole noisy crowd.
那位知名歌手一走上舞台，就能吸引整個吵鬧群眾的注意，引人注目。
command an army: At only twenty-five, the young general was chosen to command an army of ten thousand soldiers.
年僅二十五歲，這位年輕將軍就被選為指揮一支萬人軍隊。
command a view of: Our hotel room was on the top floor, so it could command a view of the whole harbor and the islands beyond.
我們的飯店房間在頂樓，因此能俯瞰整個港口和遠方的島嶼。
